mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id AS "userId", r.title, r.template, r.style::text AS style, r.content::text AS content, r.deleted, r.created_at AS "createdAt", r.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resume r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT FROM resume r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = FALSE
INSERT INTO resume (user_id, title, template, style, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{template}, CAST(#{style} AS jsonb), CAST(#{content} AS jsonb)) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET title = #{title}, template = #{template}, style = CAST(#{style} AS jsonb), content = CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE resume SET title = #{title}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE resume SET deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE
